organization.description: End-to-end actuarial reserving platform: IBNR reserving with Chain-Ladder and Bornhuetter-Ferguson, cash flow projection and IFRS 17 discounting.

note: Actuarius runs an AI agent inside the authenticated product, where it operates the reserving, cash flow, discounting and data modules on the signed-in user's behalf. That agent is not exposed as an external A2A or MCP endpoint, so the list above is intentionally empty. The resources below are what an external agent can use today.
